decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (No. 01 - Existing Floor Plans; No. 02 - Existing/Proposed Elevations; No. 03 - Proposed 1st Floor Plan; No. 04 - Proposed 2nd Floor Plan; No. 05 - Proposed Section; Unnumbered Location Plan - Received: 16/12/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension incorporating three front roof windows to the house
